title: Brother Paul, his father and relatives who played music
summary: He played with his brother, who had a little piano and drums; his father painted and owned a mandolin but no one else played.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Was there any special clarinet players that you used to hear and get ideas from? You know, things that you'd whistle and then play there? Well, I think I like a little bit from the Sender County guys. Yeah. On the records? Yeah.
I'm back to your brother. Did he play with bands ever? No. He had started out on drums. He just played a few jobs. He'd keep them all. What was his name? Paul. Paul Garland.
Your dad, did he play any music, your father? No.
When I was a boy, I know my dad had a bandolet, but I don't know if I ever remember him playing.
Did you say he was a carpenter? Did somebody say that? A painter. A painter.
Did any of your uncles play or grandfather? I don't know. I just took it up because I just liked clarinet so much. A band without a clarinet.
